That's a potential 100+ meals at half price for a 12 month period! Members can also enjoy unlimited weekend breaks at fantastic hotels around the island plus unlimited spa/beauty treatments at some of the best spas... and save 50% off the normal prices too! It is estimated that the average Gusto member saves around €800 in a year just on dining. 

This app can be used by anyone as a restaurant and establishment guide. 

To join Gusto Malta, go to https://www.gusto.com.mt and click on Join Now. If there are still memberships available you can register and pay online.

=======================================

FEATURES OF THIS APP:

NEAR ME
* Find Gusto establishments near your current location
* See the route to Gusto restaurants from your current location
* Call restaurants directly from the app
* View up-to-date restaurant information, discount availability, photos and ratings/reviews

SEARCH

* Search for Gusto establishments by name, location, discount availability, amenities or by cuisine
* Sort your results by distance from current location, members' rating and alphabetical order.

REDEEM DISCOUNTS & MORE

* If you are a Gusto member, you can use the app to redeem discounts straight from your phone
* Check how much you've saved with Gusto
* Keep track of which restaurants you've visited
* Rate and review restaurants
* Share your Gusto discoveries and savings on Fb
